messages.author: Claude
messages.body:
**11. The progress message is inferred, not reported**

The stages a customer sees are deduced from the charge: a succeeded charge means "packing" (worker/worker.go:184); a charge whose next action is a bank redirect means "bank"… So "Confirm the payment with your bank" really means "the provider says the next action is a redirect to the bank".
